name: ship
whenToInvoke: After review passes. Test → health (≥7) → review → push → PR. Gate on health score.
workflow:
1. Tests: run full test suite
2. Health: mia health (score ≥ 7)
3. Review: mia review (if not done)
4. Changelog: auto-generate
5. Push: git push origin <branch>
6. PR: gh pr create --fill

constitutionalAlignment.reasoning: Ship delivers value to user. Health gate ensures safety/ethical compliance first. Primary value: Helpful (genuinely useful delivery).
